procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial review in this session, without spawning, resuming, forking or reading peers. Read the exact packet, case, rules, rubric, recording addendum, recording README, adapter and ratio policy; verified declared input hashes/byte counts. Read the pinned source manifest and all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded unlisted paths. No protected-layout manifests are declared. Actually opened the source PNG first with tools.view_image(detail=original) and emitted its returned image through functions.exec. Then actually opened and emitted all fifteen exact poster PNGs, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. All fifteen views were complete before beginning the first copy-reading/transcription stage or any judgment or score. Read the already displayed native pixels for the untouched first transcriptions; use/thumbnail pixels informed reading scale and set comparisons. No ambiguity-triggered revisits occurred. The receipts attest to actual displayed images, not helper exits or filenames; no runtime session or opening-event ID is claimed. PNG headers independently match packet dimensions and RGB opaque encoding: native 1672x941, usage720 720x405, thumbnail320 320x180 for every member. Native 16:9 is not mathematically exact; it passes the declared single-edge rounding rule because abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5 pixels. These are pixel judgments; source inclusion inside the generation calls is not established by the allowed manifest contents.
